faq: Which platforms can you move from?
Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, Wix, Squarespace and CSV exports from custom systems are all common starting points. Send us your current platform and we confirm the route before we begin.
Will my customers need new passwords?
Customer records move over, but passwords cannot be copied between platforms. Shoppers get a reset email on first login. We can draft a short note you can send ahead of launch.
We set up redirects for your old links and keep page titles and descriptions, which helps. No migration can promise unchanged rankings, but we build it to protect as much as possible.
Does my old store go offline?
No. We copy data and leave your current store running. You choose the day to switch your domain, and we help with that step if you want.
desc:
To migrate to BigCommerce with your data and redirects intact, you need a careful plan. Ecom Swift LLC maps your fields, runs a test import for you to check, then moves products, customers and orders and sets up redirects for your old links.

## What does it mean to migrate to BigCommerce?

Migrating to BigCommerce means moving your catalog, customer accounts and order history from your current platform into a BigCommerce store, and keeping your old web addresses working. It is more than copying files. Each platform stores products, options, categories and customers in its own way, so the data has to be translated.

A good migration leaves shoppers with the same products, the same accounts and the same links, only on a new platform.

## What goes wrong in a rushed move

The common failures are quiet ones. Product options arrive as plain text instead of selectable variants. Images attach to the wrong items. Categories flatten into one list. Old links return error pages, so search engines and bookmarked customers hit dead ends. Customers log in to find their history missing.

None of this is visible until after launch, which is the worst time to find it. A migration that tests first and compares data side by side catches these problems while the old store is still live.

## How migration quality affects the business

Your old store has earned its place in search results and in customers' habits. Redirects tell search engines where each old page now lives, so the pages you have built up do not simply vanish. Customer and order history keep service smooth, since support staff can still look up past purchases.

Clean product data helps too. Correct options, images and categories mean the new store works properly from day one. Search positions can still move after any platform change, so we describe what we protect, not a promised outcome.

## What a complete migration includes

- A field map between your old platform and BigCommerce, agreed with you.
- Products imported with images, options and prices.
- Categories and brands recreated so the structure matches your plan.
- Customer accounts imported, in the packages that include them.
- Order history moved, in the packages that include it.
- Pages and blog posts copied across.
- Redirects from old product and category addresses to the new ones.
- Coupon and tax rules recreated where needed.
- A sample import for you to review before the full run.
- A side-by-side data check after the import.

## How we run the move

First we study your current store and agree what moves and what stays behind. We map the fields, then import a small sample into your BigCommerce store so you can inspect real products, options and images.

After your approval, we run the full import and compare the results against the source. We then build the redirect list and apply it. The Basic package moves products and categories with images and options. Standard adds customers, redirects, pages, blog posts and a full data comparison. Premium moves order history, recreates coupon and tax rules and supports you on launch day when the cutover happens.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Keep your old store running until the new one is checked.
- Export a full backup of your current data before we start.
- Tell us which old products or customers you no longer need.
- Check the sample import carefully, especially options and images.
- Review the redirect list for your most visited pages.

**Avoid:**
- Cancelling your old platform before launch day is complete.
- Changing products in the old store after the export without telling us.
- Moving every outdated product just because it exists.
- Switching your domain before redirects are in place.
- Skipping a test order on the new store.

## Who this is for

This service suits a store owner leaving another platform for BigCommerce, a seller with years of orders and customers who cannot afford to lose them, and a business whose current platform no longer fits and which wants a planned, checked move.

## What we need from you

An export of your products, customers and orders, or access to your current store as a staff or collaborator user, so we can pull them ourselves. We also need a BigCommerce store ready to receive the data. We never need your passwords. Customer passwords usually cannot be moved between platforms, so we plan with you how shoppers will set new ones.
